jobs_results.title: Manager/Senior Manager PMO
jobs_results.description:
At ICON, it’s our people that set us apart. Our diverse teams enable us to become a better partner to our customers and help us to fulfil our mission to advance and improve patients’ lives.

Our ‘Own It’ culture is driven by four key values that bring us together as individuals and set us apart as an organisation: Accountability & Delivery, Collaboration, Partnership, and Integrity. We want to be the Clinical Research Organisation that delivers excellence to our clients and to patients at every touch-point. In short, to be the partner of choice in drug development.

That’s our vision. We’re driven by it. And we need talented people who share it.
If you’re as driven as we are, join us. You’ll be working in a dynamic and supportive environment, with some of the brightest and the friendliest people in the sector, and you’ll be helping shape an industry.

As a Manager/Senior Manager, Program Management Office, you will be part of the PMO group within Large Pharma. You will be adding value... through delivering successful support to the project management and clinical trial management groups as well as successfully delivering transformational change management projects and contributing to a culture of project group excellence.

The Role
• Deliver assigned change projects in collaboration with other services across ICON.
• Deliver change management initiatives ensuring on-time and within budget delivery.
• Deliver and support ICON University in training, onboarding, and upskilling programs within Large Pharma Program Management (IPH).
• Participate in periodic review and revision of IPH Program Management owned SOPs/ Policies/ Guidelines.
• Provide support in responding to process queries from Program Management group.
• May need to participate in process audit pertaining to IPH Program Management processes.
• May need to provide support in responding to RFI/RFPs.
• Performs additional relevant responsibilities as requested by management.

What You Need

• 3-5 years’ work experience within Project Management
• Have a Degree in a Life Sciences or related discipline.
• Customer focussed with the ability to build excellent rapport with business partners.
• Excellent knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint.
• Comfortable with presenting to groups.
• Super organised and remains calm in taking care of multiple priorities and working to tight deadlines.
• Passionate about developing a career within the PMO.
• Benefits of Working in ICON:
Our success depends on the knowledge, capabilities and quality of our people. That’s why we are committed to developing our employees in a continuous learning culture – one where we challenge you with engaging work and where every experience adds to your professional development.

At ICON, our focus is to provide you with a comprehensive and competitive total reward package that comprises, not only an excellent level of base pay, but also a wide range of variable pay and recognition programs. In addition, our best in class employee benefits, supportive policies and wellbeing initiatives are tailored to support you and your family at all stages of your career - both now, and into the future.

ICON, including subsidiaries, is an equal opportunity and inclusive employer and is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or in order to perform the essential functions of a position, please let us know through the form below.

#LI-JD122

jobs_results.title: SAP Project Manager/SAP Expert
jobs_results.description:
Eviden, part of the Atos Group, with an annual revenue of circa € 5 billion is a global leader in data-driven, trusted and sustainable digital transformation. As a next generation digital business with worldwide leading positions in digital, cloud, data, advanced computing and security, it brings deep expertise for all industries in more than 47 countries. By uniting unique high-end technologies across the full digital continuum with 53,000 world-class talents, Eviden expands the possibilities of data and technology, now and for generations to come.

Eviden Spain is seeking a qualified and experienced SAP Project Manager to join our team in Madrid, working closely with our client to drive the project successfully.

What Impact You Can Make:

As an SAP Expert at Eviden Spain, your expertise will contribute to the efficient execution of key processes, ensuring project visibility through status reporting, risk management, and coordination of various stakeholders.

Role and... Responsibilities:
• Coordinate cross-functional teams, manage project execution, and ensure effective project management.
• Implementacion of basic project processes to ensure project visibility, covering activities such as reporting, risk and dependency management.
• Utilize budget management knowledge, understanding P&L, forecasting, and invoicing basics (though not directly responsible for invoicing).
• Effectively use project management tools such as Planner, Asana, ClickUp, or others to streamline processes.
• Apply your expertise in agile methodologies, specifically within the SCRUM framework.
• Work 100% on-site in the client office in Madrid, demonstrating your commitment to project success.

Required Skills and Experience:
• Studies in systems engineering, computer science, or a related field.
• Previous experience as a Business Analyst (BA) or Business Partner (BP) is desirable.
• Proven experience leading teams and coordinating different stakeholders.
• Proficient in project visibility processes, including status reporting, risk, and dependency management.
• Knowledge of budget management, P&L, forecasting, and invoicing basics.
• Familiarity with project management tools such as Planner, Asana, ClickUp, or similar.
• Expertise in agile methodologies, specifically the SCRUM framework, and traditional project management methodologies.
• Mandatory proficiency in Spanish; Fluent in English.

Our Offering
• Half-day Fridays.
• Intensive work day in summer.
• Personalized training and upskilling program.
• Flexible working hours.

#LI-SB6

Let’s grow together

jobs_results.title: Project Manager, People PMO
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: Spain

Description
Position at Confluent Spain, S.L.

Confluent is pioneering a fundamentally new category of data infrastructure focused on data in motion. Have you ever found a new favourite series on Netflix, picked up groceries curbside at Walmart, or paid for something using Square? That’s the power of data in motion in action—giving organisations instant access to the massive amounts of data that is constantly flowing throughout their business. At Confluent, we’re building the foundational platform for this new paradigm of data infrastructure. Our cloud-native offering is designed to be the intelligent connective tissue enabling real-time data, from multiple sources, to constantly stream across the organisation. With Confluent, organisations can create a central nervous system to innovate and win in a digital-first world.

We’re looking for self-motivated team members who crave a challenge and feel energised to roll up their... sleeves and help realise Confluent’s enormous potential. Chart your own path and take healthy risks as we solve big problems together. We value having diverse teams and want you to grow as we grow—whether you’re just starting out in your career or managing a large team, you’ll be amazed at the magnitude of your impact.

About the Role:

Confluent is looking for a functional Project Manager to act as a force-multiplier focused on increasing execution efficiency. Reporting to the Head of People Strategy and PMO, you’ll serve as a centralized resource and partner closely with all of our People functions and other cross-functional stakeholders.

In this role you will provide support on projects and work streams focused on the People orgs transformation, operational excellence and strategic improvements. As a ‘go-to’ person, you will be instrumental in guiding the seamless transition from big picture to details while navigating tight timelines. You will facilitate cohesive collaboration within and across organizations by providing operational discipline, identifying and mitigating dependencies and risks, and forging strong relationships through effective communication.

What You Will Do:
• Drive planning processes by leading conversations with key stakeholders to develop concepts into defined deliverables and ensure execution reliability.
• Continuously improve and scale the People organization by sharing project frameworks, tools, and best practices that can be easily adopted to increase delivery efficiency.
• Lead and manage complex and large scale cross-team, cross-functional initiatives from inception through deployment including defining scope and execution milestones.
• Proactively evaluate and resolve obstacles and balance competing priorities through fluid communication with project stakeholders.
• Engage and energize project teams to achieve aggressive goals.
• Leverage general knowledge to conduct simple analyses and establish performance metrics.
• Solicit and evaluate feedback to determine appropriate actions, solutions and initiatives needed.
• Create and deliver clear and detailed documentation and presentations for complex projects.

What You Will Bring:
• Strong project management skills and ability to manage competing priorities without losing sight of the most important initiatives.
• Practical working knowledge and experience in human resources with at least one full deployment project leveraging key HR systems (e.g. HCM/HRIS, LMS, ATS, etc.).
• Demonstrable experience in analyzing business needs and aligning them to project execution and KPIs.
• Exceptional interpersonal skills to be able to influentially drive alignment among stakeholders while ensuring execution accountability across teams.
• Deductive problem solving for moderate to highly complex problems; some limited data analysis may be required.
• Proven ability to clearly document and articulate goals, requirements, timelines, resources and risk within and across cross-functional teams.

What Gives You an Edge:
• Experience with Workday
• Exposure to Tableau
• PMP certification(s)
• Experience working in high growth public company setting

Come As You Are

At Confluent, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. The more diverse we are, the richer our community and the broader our impact. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law.

Click HERE to review our Candidate Privacy Notice which describes how and when Confluent, Inc., and its group companies, collects, uses, and shares certain personal information of California job applicants and prospective employees.

jobs_results.title: Business Analyst - Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
We are Addyou, a new consulting concept where we combine agile selection processes, supported by technology and analysis, but without losing focus on the most important thing, PEOPLE. We are specialized in IT, Digital & Engineer.

We want to meet you!

Our client is a multinational software company with offices in Germany, France and Japan. They are currently opening new offices in Barcelona and we are collaborating with them in the selection of people for the Business Analyst team. It isn´t a data profile

💥💥 Who are they? They are Sollers Consulting, a multinational with more than 700 professionals who work building the digital future for companies in the banking and insurance sector at an international level. They continue to grow, they have chosen Valencia and are looking for people who like challenges and ambitious projects with a high level of technical demand.

👍🏻⚡️ They are a company that places a lot of value on people and that is why they are the center of their culture... You know why? We tell you what you will find when you arrive at Sollers Consulting.

• An onboarding at the headquarters, Warsaw, where you will learn about the history of Sollers Consulting and you will be trained in tools, processes and you will be able to meet your colleagues from Poland.

• You will be assigned a coach who will accompany you during on boarding and afterwards to ensure proper development.

• A personal Budget to continue training.

• A highly qualified team that will allow you to tackle projects with great technical demands.

• Semi-annual evaluations to analyze your performance and promote promotion.

• You will work under the framework of Agile methodology (Scrum) which will allow you to have autonomy and actively participate in the projects.

👋🏻👋🏻 As you can see at Sollers Consulting you have a great journey!

🚀 What will be your responsibilities?
• You will be part of the team that implements IT solutions for financial institutions and you will have to understand the needs of customers to offer the right solutions.
• You will create concepts for implementation in close coordination with the IT team.
• You will define functional requirements and test created solutions.
• You will support B2B sales activities.

🚀 What do we expect from you?
• English & Spanish
• Minimum experience of 2/3 years in core systems implementation projects.
• Analytical thinking and ability to synthesize to present results.
• Ability to learn quickly in a challenging environment.
• Ability to work in a team with different roles.
• Availability to travel regularly.

🚀 What do we offer you?
• It’s permanent positions.
• Personal training budget.
• 25 days of vacation.
• Six-monthly evaluations to analyze promotion possibilities based on results.
• Participation in international projects.
• Work with a mixed model (2 days in the office).
• Salary range depending on experience.
• Attractive remuneration package (SBA, bonus and variable, social benefits

jobs_results.title: Salesforce Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
As a Salesforce Project Manager you will oversees the planning, execution, and successful delivery of projects related to Salesforce, a popular Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platform.

Role & Responsibilities
• Develop detailed project plans outlining tasks, timelines, and resource requirements.
• Regularly communicate with stakeholders to ensure alignment on project goals, expectations, and progress.
• Assessing risks, opportunities, deliverables, and threats for projects.
• Manage a team of developers and consultants in developing Salesforce projects.

Skills & Qualifications
• 3 + years of experience working with Salesforce on different platforms.
• Salesforce Administrator Certification.
• Project experience with Health organizations is a plus.
• Salesforce administration/configuration work (for example: workflow rules, process builder, UX updates, reporting, etc.)
• Expertise in project management tooling and workflows (Jira, Wrike, etc.)

Benefits
• Flexible remote work... policy (you can decide if you'd like to work 100% remotely or come to our offices in Barcelona or Madrid)
• Flexible working hours
• Summer schedule in July and August
• Enjoy every other Friday as a day off!
• Career path with continuous training

jobs_results.title: Footprint Project Manager - Europe
jobs_results.description:
About Lubrizol

The Lubrizol Corporation, a Berkshire Hathaway company, is a specialty chemical company whose science delivers sustainable solutions to advance mobility, improve wellbeing and enhance modern life. Founded in 1928, Lubrizol owns and operates more than 100 manufacturing facilities, sales, and technical offices around the world and has about 8,000 employees. For more information, visit www.Lubrizol.com.

We value diversity in professional backgrounds and life experiences. By enabling a consistent, unbiased, and transparent recruitment process, Lubrizol seeks to create a positive experience for candidates so we can get to know them at their best. We recognise unique work and life situations and offer flexibility, ensuring our employees feel engaged and fulfilled in every aspect of life.

Job Title : Footprint Project Manager

Job Location : Hazelwood (UK) or Sant Cugat (Barcelona)

Job type : Permanent

Type of Role : Hybrid

Join Our Thriving Team at Lubrizol as Footprint... Project Manager!

Unleash Your Potential! At Lubrizol we're transforming the footprint optimization and looking for exceptional talent to join us on this journey. If you are ready to join an international company with 8000 employees around the world and want to make a real impact, we want you on our team!

What You'll Do:

As a Footprint Project Manager for Europe, you'll be at the forefront of our footprint optimization, driving exciting projects and initiatives and will assist in developing a network map for manufacturing facilities and consolidation plans that align with the business. You will be responsible for coordinating multi-disciplinary teams to implement and complete large-scale projects that align with the business strategy and goals for Lubrizol with the objective of optimizing the footprint of Lubrizol in Europe.

What We're Looking For:

• Responsible for the coordination, implementation, control, and completion of projects, while remaining aligned with strategy, commitments, and goals of Lubrizol.

• Set deadlines, manage work stream owners within different departments, assign responsibilities, and monitor and summarize progress of project.

• Manage closing plants' projects and closing lab projects.

• Manage product transfer projects both in coordination with plant consolidations and as a separate project.

• Support the Footprint (Network) Director in creation of the network map (an overall classification of sites and plan for consolidation, closing or maintenance)

• With support from manufacturing technology which will select the most effective technologies, create the automation and advanced manufacturing plan which will outline where and when these technologies will be put in place in the remaining plants

• Provide risk/reward trade-off to business groups for decisions

• Communicate and escalate risks that could impact objectives and deliverables

Skills That Make a Difference:

• Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university in engineering or program management

• Experience in plant closures and product transfers, particularly where customer or regulatory approvals are required

• Minimum 10 years of combined business and Operations/Manufacturing experience

• Proven track record of project management experience

• Expertise in using project management tools such as MS project

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong facilitation capability

• Exceptional critical thinking skills

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, outlook, teams, and SharePoint)

• Ability to be organized, problem solver solution oriented   

• Lean Six Sigma Black Belt is a plus

• Chemical experience is an advantage

• Willing to travel 20%-30% mainly in Europe          

Perks and Rewards That Inspire:

• Develop your professional career with a highly respected, industry-leading, multinational company that is part of Berkshire Hathaway Inc.

• Become part of a culture that is based on accountability and empowerment and which values diversity and inclusivity.

• A competitive remuneration and benefits package

It’s an exciting time to be part of Lubrizol. Lubrizol is not staying put. We are continually learning and evolving. Our passion delivers our success — not only for Lubrizol but for those who count on us every day: our employees, customers, and communities.

As a diverse, global team, we work together to solve some of the world’s most pressing challenges. We impact everyday lives through science only Lubrizol can deliver, and we never stop pushing to do it better.

One of the founding principles of The Lubrizol Corporation more than 90 years ago was treating every employee with dignity and respect. That same commitment is only stronger today.

More than that, we are committed to providing an environment where every employee can be the best they can be, no matter their ethnic origin, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or any other characteristic

We recognise unique work and life situations and offer flexibility, ensuring our employees feel engaged and fulfilled in every aspect of life.

Job Title : Footprint Project Manager

Job Location : Hazelwood (UK) or Sant Cugat (Barcelona)

Job type : Permanent

Type of Role : Hybrid

Join Our Thriving Team at Lubrizol as Footprint... Project Manager!

Unleash Your Potential! At Lubrizol we're transforming the footprint optimization and looking for exceptional talent to join us on this journey. If you are ready to join an international company with 8000 employees around the world and want to make a real impact, we want you on our team!

What You'll Do:

As a Footprint Project Manager for Europe, you'll be at the forefront of our footprint optimization, driving exciting projects and initiatives and will assist in developing a network map for manufacturing facilities and consolidation plans that align with the business. You will be responsible for coordinating multi-disciplinary teams to implement and complete large-scale projects that align with the business strategy and goals for Lubrizol with the objective of optimizing the footprint of Lubrizol in Europe.

What We're Looking For:

• Responsible for the coordination, implementation, control, and completion of projects, while remaining aligned with strategy, commitments, and goals of Lubrizol.

• Set deadlines, manage work stream owners within different departments, assign responsibilities, and monitor and summarize progress of project.

• Manage closing plants' projects and closing lab projects.

• Manage product transfer projects both in coordination with plant consolidations and as a separate project.

• Support the Footprint (Network) Director in creation of the network map (an overall classification of sites and plan for consolidation, closing or maintenance)

• With support from manufacturing technology which will select the most effective technologies, create the automation and advanced manufacturing plan which will outline where and when these technologies will be put in place in the remaining plants

• Provide risk/reward trade-off to business groups for decisions

• Communicate and escalate risks that could impact objectives and deliverables

Skills That Make a Difference:

• Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university in engineering or program management

• Experience in plant closures and product transfers, particularly where customer or regulatory approvals are required

• Minimum 10 years of combined business and Operations/Manufacturing experience

• Proven track record of project management experience

• Expertise in using project management tools such as MS project

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong facilitation capability

• Exceptional critical thinking skills

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, outlook, teams, and SharePoint)

• Ability to be organized, problem solver solution oriented   

• Lean Six Sigma Black Belt is a plus

• Chemical experience is an advantage

• Willing to travel 20%-30% mainly in Europe          

Perks and Rewards That Inspire:

• Develop your professional career with a highly respected, industry-leading, multinational company that is part of Berkshire Hathaway Inc.

• Become part of a culture that is based on accountability and empowerment and which values diversity and inclusivity.

• A competitive remuneration and benefits package

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Description
General information:

The Project Execution team is at the heart of our organization, meeting and exceeding customer expectations while helping to build a sustainable and profitable future. You will lead projects within the Transformers Business Unit.

Reporting to the Project Operations Manager you will maintain and enhance customer satisfaction by providing excellent service at all stages of the project.

The role is to be executed in our office in Cordoba (Spain).

Responsibilities:
• Leading the project team with clear guidelines, tasks and milestones, while motivating and providing feedback.
• Managing all aspects of the project to agreed-upon customer requirements and ensuring all technical, safety, quality and financial targets are met.
• Overseeing the development of project plan documents in relation to scope, budget, schedule, and risk management.
• Monitoring each stage of project implementation to ensure best practices in cost control, resource efficiency, risk... management and health, safety and the environment. Identifying, analyzing and addressing project risks, with the regular sharing of lessons learned.
• Coordinating contract negotiation and claims with customers, in collaboration with the Supply Chain and Legal functions.
• Achieving project deliverables and compliance with contract requirements.
• Building strong relationships with customers and stakeholders.
• Living core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

Your background:
• A bachelor's degree in Engineering.
• More than 3 years of experience in Project Management, in a multinational environment.
• Demonstrated experience in management of project scope, cost, schedules and vendors/subcontractor Customer oriented, with excellent organization and strong communication skills.
• Fluent in English and Spanish, both written and spoken.
• Current work permit valid in Spain.
• Knowledge of SAP
• French language and a PMI certification will be considered a plus

jobs_results.title: Data & AI Project Manager at Electronic Arts in Madrid
jobs_results.description:
EA inspires the world to play, and the Worldwide Localization Team makes that happen! We are accountable for delivering the high-quality localized versions of our titles to over 30 countries around the world. You will find a vibrant, multicultural environment with a great mixture of professionals. From software engineers, project managers, testers to audio, text and linguistic specialists, each employee has an important role to play. EA has built a cutting-edge Localization powerhouse that covers the needs for both current and next-generation platform.

We are looking for a dedicated and experienced Data & AI Project Manager to join our dynamic team at Electronic Arts (EA). This role is key to driving our digital transformation efforts, as you'll be leading projects that leverage data and AI to enhance our gaming experiences and business outcomes.

Responsibilities:
• Develop, manage, and lead complex data and AI projects from inception to completion, ensuring they are delivered on... time and within scope and budget.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, data analysts, engineers, and business stakeholders, to define project objectives, deliverables, and timelines.
• Identify, assess, and manage potential project risks and obstacles, develop effective mitigation strategies, and maintain open communication with stakeholders.
• Effectively communicate project expectations, progress, and outcomes to stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
• Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment, promoting the sharing of knowledge and expertise and driving the achievement of shared goals.
• Mentor junior team members and foster a culture of learning and sharing.

Qualifications:
• A PhD or Master's degree in Computer Science, IT, Statistics, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field.
• A minimum of 3 years of proven project management experience, focusing on data and AI-related projects.
• Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies, strongly emphasising Agile and Scrum, and knowledge of project management software, especially Jira.
• Excellent leadership, communication, and team-building skills, with a demonstrated ability to motivate and guide diverse teams.
• Ability to develop strong relationships with key stakeholders, successfully managing expectations and resolving conflicts.
• Strong strategic and problem-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate potential issues and create effective solutions.
• Demonstrated leadership skills, with experience in mentoring.
• Interest in gaming is a big plus.

Preferred Skills:
• Certifications in Project Management (PMP, Prince2), Agile, or Scrum would be advantageous.
• Experience in the gaming industry would be a significant plus.
• Familiarity with data visualization and AI tools and platforms.

#LI-VEP1

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

Could you be the full-time PROJECT MANAGER in Madrid we’re looking for?

Your future role

Take on a new challenge and apply your Project Management expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside young and talented teammates.

You'll drive Onboard Signalling project/program execution, to maximize the results with respect to cash and margin whilst delivering on time, in conformity with the contract/Program Charter according to Customer/Platform expectations and the requirements on EHS. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (Customer ... Platform (for R&D programs), Partners, Project Team, Line Managers providing resources, Project Office, Support functions (Finance, Tax, Legal, etc..) and other project stakeholders).

You’ll specifically take care of seeking and proposing to the Customer Director/Project Leader/Platform additional opportunities in the frame of the contract Charter, ensuring that Alstom Transport legal and contractual rights are protected.

We’ll look to you for:
• Plan and manage the complete execution of his/her scope from transfer to close out, in line with Contract / Program Charter requirements.
• Lead a Project Team, including Core Team and when applicable Project Managers of internal and external partners - in line with the project structure.
• Perform project management and contract administration according to Alstom Project Management Manual (PMM), including proactive risk and opportunity management, and in full compliance with E&C rules.
• Ensure completion of Project / Program Performance goals to meet business objectives and customer / Platform satisfaction.
• For Projects: Responsible and accountable for the Project Profit and Loss; For Programs: Respect the budgets and QCD objectives defined during PAB.
• Ensure optimal quality of project/program execution and reviews.
• Ensure that critical aspects are identified in reviews and proactively / professionally addressed and followed up.
• Manage the situation of the project / program and its KPIs, and report to senior management, with transparency during the business/sector project reviews or PRB.
• Make sure that key project stakeholders are aligned towards project/program goals.
• Represent Alstom towards Customers and when applicable external stakeholders (Consortium, JV …)
• EHS: Accountable for the proper implementation of the Alstom policy and Customer / Platform requirements by all stakeholders (internal & external) including suppliers and contractors.
• Responsible to ensure full compliance with Code of Ethics

Performance measurements:
• Sales
• Physical progress
• Gate review Go on time / OTD- GR
• GM adjusted and GM
• Cash-in
• Customer Satisfaction
• EHS when aplicable

All about you

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
• University degree in Engineering or Civil Engineering
• Language skills: High level in English is a must. French other language is an asset
• Previous experience of 5 years of relevant Project Management experience. Desirable career experience in Railways and good knowledge of railway products and systems.
• Recognized project management qualification will be a plus.
• Good knowledge of Project management processes (background level depending on the complexity of the Project/Program)
• Experience in managing wide range subcontractor companies along with several different typology of products
• Experience of working in and with multi-national companies and in different business cultures
• Used to work on a goal-driven basis environment
• Conflict management and interpersonal skills
• Team spirit approach and good communication skills,
• Abilities to obtain collaboration and “pull together” all parties involved in the project (especially in case of complex PIO)
• Anticipation, clear reporting,
• Leadership, entrepreneurship mindset and decision minded.
• Strong skills and resilience to manage uncertainty

Things you’ll enjoy

Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
• Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
• Work with new security standards for rail signalling
• Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
• Contribute to innovative projects
• Utilise our Agile working environment
• Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
• Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
• Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Important to note

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 70+ countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone
